pass_b_english: II. Among outstanding theologians there are various treatments and divisions of it.
Doctor Conrad Bergius, in his praised Precognita, refers the tractations of sacred things to five modes.
The first is HISTORY, which is discourse about singular past deeds; in it the order of time is chiefly to be observed.

The second is PROPHECY, which is discourse about singular future deeds; in it partly the order of time is observed, partly the prudence or fitness to the particular end that God or the prophet intends.
source_text: II. Sunt autem apud praestantes Theologos variae illius tractationes & divisiones. TRACTATIONES de rebus sacris D. Conr. Bergius in laudatis praecognitis suis ad quinque modos refert. PRIMUS est HISTORIA, quae est sermo de factis singularibus praeteritis: in quo temporis potissimum ordo observandus est. SECUNDUS est PROPHETIA, quae est sermo de factis singularibus futuris: in quo partim temporis ordo observatur, partim prudentiae seu congruentiae ad finem particularem, quem Deus vel propheta intendit.
